function automatic void round_mant(
    input  logic [10:0] M_int,
    input  logic guard,
    input  logic round_bit,
    input  logic sticky,
    input  logic [2:0] rnd,
    input  logic sign_s,

);
    logic round_up;

    any_frac = guard | round_bit | sticky;
    inexact = any_frac;

            if (guard) begin
                if (round_bit | sticky | M_int[0]) round_up = 1;
                else round_up = 0;
            end else round_up = 0;

            if (sign_s) round_up = 0;
            else round_up = any_frac;
        end
        3'b100: begin // RMM
            if (guard) round_up = 1;
            else round_up = 0;
        end
        default: round_up = 0;
    endcase
    
    if (round_up) M_rounded = M_int + 1;
    else M_rounded = M_int;
